findings.correction: Describe 35323904 B as worker peak RSS through the post-verification capture point, and 164986880 B as a conservative payload RSS bound through that point. findings.evidence: The worker reads ru_maxrss after data verification but before constructing, serializing, writing and printing its result. The observer reads ru_maxrss while constructing its final result, also before serialization and exit. Neither value is externally reaped full-lifetime rusage.
findings.rerun_condition: Only a claim covering full worker/observer lifetime requires a new externally reaped measurement. This bounded cached-generation acceptance can use a wording repair.

Disk peaks cover paths beneath the private measurement root plus symlinked inputs, inode deduplicated. They exclude unlinked SQLite files and external prior comparison fixtures. They are sampled observations, not complete filesystem high-water or quota enforcement.

official_candidate_alternative.candidate_review: Before acquisition, explicitly authorize the new candidate and source scope. After capture, freeze exact source hashes/lengths/timestamps and independently review changed rows/counts, ROR closure, missing references, schema and projection invariants, candidate hashes and resource receipts. Never require different source bytes to reproduce the old output hashes; establish and review new candidate outputs while retaining old artifacts unchanged.
official_candidate_alternative.historical_limit: Missing original capture telemetry remains an evidence limitation, not necessarily a permanent plan gate. The orchestrator may close a prospective reproducible-operation requirement with this explicitly reviewed new operation; it must not claim retrospective proof for the old exact bytes.
pre_acquisition_prerequisites: Repair cached-evidence RSS capture-point wording and retain original raw receipts plus their hashes.
Create a distinct candidate ID/output root and manifest; lock generator code pins, official URL allowlist and the existing ROR release pin. Accepted artifact/publication pins remain unchanged.

Independently review the acquisition/measurement controller before download: redirect refusal, streaming hash/length validation, response/timeout handling, one aggregate 1 GiB transferred-payload limit and one 1800-second end-to-end deadline, fail-closed cleanup/retained diagnostics, serial generation, external process accounting, explicit disk scope and handling of open unlinked SQLite files.

Agree the prospective operational acceptance scope: what RSS/disk maxima are bounded or merely sampled, whether instrumentation is included, per-output 256 MiB SQLite and 2 MiB metadata ceilings, and 512 MiB RSS / 8 GiB disk limits. An unmeasured or sampled-only component must remain disclosed rather than silently counted as proven.

Do not pre-approve unknown new Geo hashes as accepted corpus data. Capture only to the separate candidate, freeze observed hashes, then perform independent source-delta/projection/resource review before operational acceptance; publication promotion remains a later gate.
official_candidate_alternative.promotion: Only later promotion of this candidate into the corpus requires regenerating and revalidating every source-dependent artifact, provenance/manifest hash, registry/Directory dependency and deployed journey that changes. Existing published artifacts stay on their original pins until that promotion passes.
official_candidate_alternative.resource_acceptance: Resource acceptance may be limited to the reviewed same-scope candidate operation. No publication or republishing all dependent artifacts is required merely to measure that operation. A major source-size/schema/scope change must not be treated as representative without review.
official_candidate_alternative.scope: Acquire current official bytes once into a distinct immutable candidate manifest, then run the same pinned serial generators within one measured envelope. This can satisfy a prospective operational capture/build budget gate without a frozen mirror. It does not demonstrate the accepted historical snapshot capture.

smallest_next_validation: Freeze the reviewed source manifest and require a designated owner to identify an authorized immutable transport location for all six exact input objects. There is no executable network acquisition of the frozen GeoNames bytes available in the supplied evidence today; do not manufacture a mirror URL or use changed mutable bytes.

Implement and independently review a small streaming acquisition controller using that manifest. Refuse redirects, stream to fresh files while hashing, enforce an aggregate 1073741824-byte cap and one 1800-second deadline covering capture, input verification, serial ROR then Geo generation, and output verification. Capture ROR once. Require exact lengths/hashes before generation; fail closed and retain diagnostic receipts on any mismatch.

Run that controller once through WB in a fresh private directory. Record acquisition URLs/timestamps and measured network payload separately from original official provenance. Reuse the exact pinned generation commands in the existing worker receipt and require the exact native SQLite hashes, Geo decoded-chunk hash, retained SQL counts/statuses and missing-reference counts.

If strict RSS/disk ceilings are part of operational acceptance, measure the controller and all child/wrapper lifetimes externally (or use an explicit enforceable memory ceiling) and use a bounded filesystem/quota that counts open unlinked SQLite temporary allocations. External instrumentation must itself have explicit scope; a supervisor exiting after serialization cannot prove its own lifetime peak.

Label the result new immutable-mirror acquisition plus build. It cannot repair the missing historical official-capture measurement. If the requirement instead mandates official upstream capture, separately review the changed monthly candidate and its provenance/semantics before acquisition/promotion; do not silently repin this snapshot.
